name: CSV + Sequence Locks
summary: BIP-68/112/113 collectively introduced CheckSequenceVerify (CSV) and relative lock-time, enabling bi-directional payment channels (Lightning Network precursor) and complex multi-step contracts with time-based conditions.
summaryZh: BIP-68/112/113 共同引入了 CheckSequenceVerify（CSV）和相对时间锁定，实现了双向支付通道（闪电网络的前身）和基于时间的复杂多步合约。
